messages:
ops-lead: Starting a microshift for /api/chat v2 -> v3. Window 01:00-01:30 UTC. Steps: 2% -> 8% -> 20% -> drain -> 50% -> 100%. Holds: 3m after 8%, 8m after 20% and 50%. Abort if p95 +200ms or 5xx >0.5% sustained 3m. Pin fallback: v2. @dev-runner will initiate drains at 20%.

deploy-bot: deploy job queued: release=2026-03-21-microshift id=ms-7701. I'll post each weight change.

ada: Linking dashboards: https://grafana.company/d/chat-api p95 baseline=78ms, errors=0.08%. Watching db pool and auth latency.

ops-lead: set 2% now

deploy-bot: routerctl: set-weight --route /api/chat --version v3 --weight 2% -> ok

chris: telemetry: p95 82ms, errors flat. All green.

ops-lead: moving to 8%

deploy-bot: routerctl: set-weight --route /api/chat --version v3 --weight 8% -> ok

ada: hold 3m. p95 90ms, tiny blip in auth latency +12ms.

ops-lead: proceed to 20%

deploy-bot: routerctl: set-weight --route /api/chat --version v3 --weight 20% -> ok

dev-runner: starting drain of blue nodes now: `kubectl -n front cordon node-blue-3 && kubectl -n front drain node-blue-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

chris: p95 jumped to 290ms and 503s at 1.0% over 2m. Abort thresholds hit.

ops-lead: rolling back to 8% and pinning v2.

deploy-bot: routerctl: set-weight --route /api/chat --version v3 --weight 8% -> ok

deploy-bot: routerctl: pin --route /api/chat --version v2 --reason "auto-rollback-auth-latency" -> ok

dev-runner: uncordon node-blue-3 -> `kubectl uncordon node-blue-3`. Stopping drains.

ada: metrics normalizing: p95 88ms, errors 0.11%.

ops-lead: Postmortem actions: add auth client retries to preflight, add canary exclusion for older infra, document rollback in release notes. Will open follow-up tickets. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
